name: Exp_ColorRsiMACD
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorRsiMACD custom indicator, which applies RSI smoothing with configurable averaging methods before computing a MACD-style oscillator. It offers four trading modes: MACD zero-line breakdown, MACD direction twist, signal line twist, and MACD-vs-signal disposition crossover, opening and closing positions accordingly.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标ColorRsiMACD进行交易，该指标先对RSI进行可配置的平滑处理，再计算类似MACD的振荡器。它提供四种交易模式：MACD零线突破、MACD方向扭转、信号线扭转和MACD与信号线交叉，据此开平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用经过多种平滑算法（如JJMA、JurX、ParMA、T3、VIDYA、AMA等）处理后的RSI值构建MACD指标，从而生成交易信号。策略提供四种入场模式：breakdown模式基于MACD线穿越零线；MACDtwist模式基于MACD线方向变化（由降转升做多，由升转降做空）；SIGNALtwist模式基于信号线方向变化；MACDdisposition模式基于MACD线与信号线的交叉。出场条件与入场条件相对应，当反向信号触发时平仓，同时设有止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode参数控制，支持固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms库中的函数实现，允许灵活配置买卖开平仓的启用状态。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy constructs a MACD indicator from RSI values processed through configurable smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA, etc.), generating trading signals from this hybrid oscillator. Four entry modes are available: breakdown mode triggers on MACD crossing the zero line; MACDtwist mode triggers on MACD direction change (declining-to-rising for buys, rising-to-declining for sells); SIGNALtwist mode triggers on signal line direction change; and MACDdisposition mode triggers on MACD/signal line crossover. Exit conditions mirror entries—reverse signals close positions, supplemented by configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enum, supporting fixed lots or percentage-of-balance sizing. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms library, and each buy/sell open/close action can be independently enabled or disabled.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数或比例）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/net margin/net balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy-side close (close sell on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell-side close (close buy on opposite signal)

pros: 提供四种灵活的交易模式，适应不同市场环境和交易风格
使用多种高级平滑算法处理RSI，减少了传统MACD的滞后性和噪音
买卖开平仓均可独立控制，策略配置灵活度高
有新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线重复交易
止损止盈参数齐全，风险控制手段基本完备
pros_en: Offers four flexible trading modes adaptable to different market conditions and trading styles
Employs multiple advanced smoothing algorithms on RSI, reducing lag and noise compared to traditional MACD
Buy/sell open/close can each be independently enabled, providing high configuration flexibility
New bar check mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same candle
Stop loss and take profit parameters are provided, giving basic risk control
cons: 止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑ATR等动态波动性指标，可能在低波动或高波动市场中不适用
缺少点差过滤，在H4周期影响较小但若切换到低周期可能因点差过大而亏损
代码中重复包含了TradeAlgorithms.mqh（第12行和第105行），存在冗余
RSI与MACD组合本质上仍然是动量类指标，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
没有持仓数量检查或最大持仓限制，可能在极端行情中过度开仓
cons_en: Fixed-pip stop loss and take profit ignore ATR-based dynamic volatility, which may be unsuitable in low- or high-volatility regimes
No spread filter; while less critical on H4, switching to lower timeframes could incur losses from excessive spreads
TradeAlgorithms.mqh is included twice (lines 12 and 105), indicating redundant code
The RSI+MACD combination remains a momentum indicator prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets
No position count check or maximum position limit, risking over-exposure in extreme market conditions
improvements: 添加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整，提高适应性
增加点差过滤和最大持仓数量检查，增强风险控制和鲁棒性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit that auto-adjusts to market volatility for better adaptability
Add a spread filter and maximum position count check to strengthen risk control and robustness

risk_points: 缺少点差过滤机制，低周期交易可能因点差导致亏损
没有最大持仓限制，连续信号可能造成过度持仓
固定点数止损止盈在极端波动市场中可能不够灵活
risk_points_en: No spread filter could cause losses on lower timeframes due to wide spreads
No maximum position limit could lead to over-exposure from consecutive signals
Fixed-pip stops may be insufficiently flexible during extreme volatility
